title: Add machine-readable review orchestration contract
summary: BCQuality now generates a deterministic, machine-readable skill index from review frontmatter and validates review composition through schemas and CI checks.
key_points: Generates versioned skill index from action-skill frontmatter for stable review orchestration
Adds JSON schemas for skill index and findings reports to define the review contract
Validates flat review structure including leaf IDs, paths, ordering, and output contracts in CI
Includes generator tests and repository validation without modifying review knowledge
Enables BC-ALAgents to consume a stable, mechanically-owned orchestration contract
quote: BC-ALAgents needs a stable contract that defines exactly which review leaves exist and their required order.
